data.one_liner: Detect file types based on content headers and magic numbers across platforms.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter package to detect file types using their magic numbers and file extensions instead of relying solely on MIME types. It reads files cross-platform using cross_file and supports mobile, desktop, and web without native code dependencies.
use_when: You need to reliably identify file types from bytes, paths, or blobs across platforms including the web.
You want to avoid relying purely on untrustworthy MIME types or file extensions provided by users.
avoid_when: You require deep content inspection or parsing of complex document internals beyond basic file type detection.
strengths: Supports mobile, desktop, and web without native code dependencies.
Allows dynamic registration of custom file signatures, extensions, and MIME-to-type mappings.
Optimized stream reading prevents high memory usage on large files.
weaknesses: Limited to predefined file type signatures unless custom types are explicitly registered.
